title: Contain and verify necessary unsafe Rust and FFI boundaries
summary: For each necessary unsafe Rust operation or C FFI boundary in an authorized C-to-Rust port, prefer safe Rust where feasible, isolate the boundary, document required safety and ABI invariants, and test the exposed contract.
statement: For each necessary unsafe Rust operation or C FFI boundary in an authorized C-to-Rust port, prefer safe Rust where feasible, isolate the boundary, document required safety and ABI invariants, and test the exposed contract.
rationale: Safety and ABI assumptions hidden across modules are difficult to audit. Restricting and exercising necessary boundaries reduces undefined behavior and compatibility risk without forbidding justified interoperability.

conditions: An authorized C-to-Rust port uses Rust unsafe operations or an FFI boundary.
exceptions: No unsafe or FFI boundary is required when a fully safe Rust implementation can express the behavior.
